rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being uncertain or not sure about something.

example.english: I'm unsure whether he'll come back today.
example.traditional: 我唔肯定佢今日會唔會返嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hang2 ding6 keoi5 gam1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this when the speaker has not made up their mind about a choice or course of action.

example.english: I'm still unsure whether to go on a trip tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我仲未諗定聽日去唔去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 nam2 ding6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this for something physically or situationally unstable, such as unsure footing or insecure support.

example.english: I feel unsure on the wet stairs because my footing isn't steady.
example.traditional: 行濕滑嘅樓梯要慢慢行，我覺得腳步唔穩。
example.jyutping: haang4 sap1 waat6 ge3 lau4 tai1 jiu3 maan6 maan2 haang4 ngo5 gok3 dak1 goek3 bou6 m4 wan2
